name: desktop-ui-verification
goal: Desktop browser scenarios pass with current catalogs and controls, correct image lifecycles and no overflow or browser errors.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Baseline 418f9e426 reproduces the same 45 Desktop browser failures as 6f9dba967. Restore current contract behavior and standard flows, fix image URL errors and responsive overflow, then require the complete browser and repository checks.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Prior full checks stopped before Desktop E2E. Existing error and overflow guards detect the faults. Updated the standard scenarios and shared fixtures for seven categories, modal search, chat modes and access selection; added model search, decoded-image and immutable-chat assertions before product changes.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Preserved diagnostic runs 022ff344 and a38f2305 include capture setup gaps. Declare the existing Examples screenshot states, retain every assertion, and repeat the stamped run before product changes.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
